review: triage 701.30b: reclassified from decision to mechanical (clashing with an opponent makes that opponent clash too, observable as B's reveal and library move); added it to 701.30a-1, whose b_bottom variant shows it
701.30a-1 listed 701.30b, which applies in every variant (both players clash), so a_top was no near miss of it; 701.30b moved to 701.30b-1.

scenarios.title: A clashing player reveals the top card of their library and may put it on the bottom

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A casts Fistful of Force targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Forests.
Both players pass; Fistful of Force resolves and A clashes with B.
Both players reveal their top card (A reveals Hill Giant, B reveals Island). A decides first: A puts Hill Giant on the bottom. B leaves Island on top.

variants.label: a_bottom
variants.expected: A's library from the top is Plains, Forest, Hill Giant. B's library from the top is Island, Mountain, Swamp.

variants.label: a_top
variants.delta: A leaves Hill Giant on top.
variants.expected: A's library from the top is Hill Giant, Plains, Forest. B's library from the top is Island, Mountain, Swamp.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A keeps its revealed card on top instead of bottoming it

variants.label: b_bottom
variants.delta: B also puts Island on the bottom.
variants.expected: A's library from the top is Plains, Forest, Hill Giant. B's library from the top is Mountain, Swamp, Island.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B bottoms its revealed card

detector.outcome: A clash resolution moves a revealed top card of a library to the bottom.
detector.near_miss: A clash resolution that left the revealed card on top.

scenarios.title: Clashing with an opponent makes both players clash

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A casts Fistful of Force targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Forests.
Both players pass; Fistful of Force resolves and A clashes with B.
Both players reveal their top card (A reveals Hill Giant, B reveals Island). A decides first: A puts Hill Giant on the bottom. B leaves Island on top.

variants.label: both_clash
variants.expected: A and B both reveal their top card and choose: A's library from the top is Plains, Forest, Hill Giant. B's library from the top is Island, Mountain, Swamp.

variants.label: b_bottom
variants.delta: B also puts Island on the bottom.
variants.expected: Both players still clash; only B's choice differs. A's library from the top is Plains, Forest, Hill Giant. B's library from the top is Mountain, Swamp, Island.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B bottoms its revealed card

scenarios.forge_notes: Every clash card clashes with an opponent, so no board shows the rule not applying: the contrast is other, and the detector counts the fires side only.

detector.outcome: A clash with an opponent resolves (a clash_resolved event): both players revealed and chose.
detector.near_miss: None counted: a clash is always with an opponent, and outcome_event counts a near miss only with an api or keyword.

scenarios.title: The clash is won only by the strictly highest revealed mana value

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first. Hill Giant has mana value 4 and Island has mana value 0.

decisions: A casts Fistful of Force targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Forests.
Both players pass; Fistful of Force resolves and A clashes with B.
Both players reveal their top card; each puts it back on top.

variants.label: higher
variants.expected: A reveals Hill Giant (4) and B reveals Island (0): A wins. Grizzly Bears gets +2/+2 and then another +2/+2 and trample until end of turn: a 6/6 with trample.

variants.label: tie
variants.delta: B's top card is Hill Giant too (mana value 4).
variants.expected: Both reveal mana value 4: nobody wins. Grizzly Bears gets only +2/+2 until end of turn: a 4/4 without trample.

variants.label: lower
variants.delta: B's top card is Craw Wurm (mana value 6).
variants.expected: A reveals mana value 4 and B reveals mana value 6: A does not win. Grizzly Bears is a 4/4 without trample until end of turn.

detector.outcome: A clash resolution in which the clashing player won (a clash_resolved event with won true): their revealed card's mana value was higher than every other revealed card's.
detector.near_miss: A clash resolution in which the clashing player did not win, on a tie or a lower mana value.
